newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Lindsey says U.S. inflation moderate.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Lindsey says U.S. inflation moderate.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey on Tuesday described U.S. inflation as "moderate."
Following a speech to a Women in Housing and Finance luncheon, Lindsey told reporters that inflation was currently at a desirable level for the housing sector.
He said in his speech, which focused on community lending, that a low-inflation environment had been favorable for redevelopment.
"I think we'll continue to get moderate inflation," Lindsey said.
Asked about news from the Commerce Department that housing starts fell 5.1 percent in October, Lindsey responded that the decline was "part of the natural cycle."
